{{#if:{{{type|}}}|{{#switch: {{lc:{{{type}}}}} | online = [[Category:Online tournaments]] | ground | local = [[Category:Local tournaments]] }} }} == Usage == === Parameters === ==== League information ==== ;name : The name of the league ;image : Name of the image on the wiki, including file extension, for the league logo. e.g. image = LeagueLogo.png. This image will be sized to 220 pixels wide. ;organizer : A semicolon separated list of the organisers, e.g. organizer = [[ArenaNet]]; [http://mmorpg.com MMORPG.com], [http://mistleague.com Mist League]. ;sponsor : A semicolon separated list of the name of the sponsors. ;patch : Build number on which the tournament was played (this can usually be found in the wiki patch notes of the latest patch, or in the in-game options) ;server : North America or Europe ;type : The type of tournament :* ''online'' - Tournaments that take place on live servers :* ''offline'' :* ''local'' - Tournaments that take place on ground, such as in an expo. ;country ;format : What format matches were played in (Single Elimination, Double Elimination, Group Stages, or a combination thereof). ;prize : Total prize pool of the event. ;date ;startDate ;endDate : Use date if event is held on a single day, start date and end date if it's over a period of time. ==== Winners ==== ;firstPlace ;secondPlace ;thirdPlace ;fourthPlace ;semiFinals ;semiFinals2 : The names of the winning 4 teams / players. Use thirdPlace and fourthplace if a third place match was played, if not, use semiFinals and semiFinals2 instead. ==== Teams and Maps ==== ;teamNumber : the number of competing teams ;maps : Unlinked comma separated lists. e.g. maps = Battle of Kyhlo, Forest of Niflhel, Legacy of the Foefire [[Category:Infobox templates|League]]

 == Description == This template displays the legendary unlock text. == Usage == 
{{Legendary unlock text|}}
=== Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Required. Legendary unlock text. Sets [[Property:Has legendary unlock text]]. ;aurene : Optional. If set then it displays an image of Aurene (End of Dragons Generation 3 legendary weapons) instead of the book. Used on default if the page name includes the keyword "Aurene". ;title : Optional. Defaults to PAGENAME. ;icon : Optional. Defaults to the corresponding game icon of the PAGENAME. ;pagename : Optional. Used for non-mainspace, overview or debug purposes, overrides the default PAGENAME. ;height : Optional. Legendary unlock text height to provide a consistent format on overview pages. ;image : Optional. Allows to set a custom image. Set to "none" to disable the image. === Example === 
{{Legendary unlock text
| pagename = Eternity      
| Although the [[Six Human Gods|gods]] have abandoned [[Tyria]], their gifts remain. The oceans and land. The verdant forests, the limitless cosmos beyond—the ultimate love letter to the living, but also a solemn good-bye.
}}

{{#if: {{#vardefine: filter-level | {{#arraymap: {{{level|80}}}|,|$$$| {{#arraymap: $$$ |-|@@@| {{#ifeq: {{#expr: (0 < @@@) and (@@@ < 80) }} | 1 | f-belowlevel80 }} {{#ifeq: @@@ | 80 | f-level80 }} | }} }} }} {{#vardefine: filter-rarity | {{#arraymap: {{lc: {{{rarity|Exotic}}} }} |,|@@@| f-@@@ | }} {{#if: {{#replace: {{lc: {{{rarity|Exotic}}} }} | skin | }} | f-armor }} }} {{#vardefine: filter-release | f-{{lc: {{{release|core}}} }} }} }}{{!}}- class="filter-row {{#arraymap: {{lc: {{{filters|}}} }}|,|@@@|f-@@@| }} {{#var:filter-level}} {{#var:filter-rarity}} {{#var:filter-release}}" | style="text-align:right" | {{increment|counter}} {{#var:counter}} | {{#ifeq: {{{link|}}} | no | {{{1|}}} | [[{{{link|{{{1|}}} }}}|{{{1|}}}]] }} | {{#ifeq: {{{light|}}} | no | — | {{#arraymap:{{{light |{{{1|}}} (light) }}}|,|@@@|[[@@@|{{#explode:@@@|(|0}}]]|, }} }} | {{#ifeq: {{{medium|}}} | no | — | {{#arraymap:{{{medium|{{{1|}}} (medium)}}}|,|@@@|[[@@@|{{#explode:@@@|(|0}}]]|, }} }} | {{#ifeq: {{{heavy|}}} | no | — | {{#arraymap:{{{heavy |{{{1|}}} (heavy) }}}|,|@@@|[[@@@|{{#explode:@@@|(|0}}]]|, }} }} | style="text-align:center" | {{#ifeq: {{{level|}}} | no | — | {{#arraymap: {{{level|80}}} |,|@@@|@@@|, }} }} | {{#arraymap: {{lc: {{{rarity|Exotic}}} }} |,|@@@| {{#ifeq: @@@ | skin | Skin | {{rarity|@@@}} }} |, }} == Description == This template gives an overview of all available [[armor sets]]. == Usage == 
{{List of armor set table row||light=|medium=|heavy=|level=|rarity=|filters=}}
=== Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' :Armor set. ;link :Link to the armor set, if ''no'' then the armor set name is plain text. ;light :Light armor set page, default is ''parameter 1'' with the suffix ''(light)''. Multiple sets allowed, seperated with comma. ;medium :Medium armor set page, default is ''parameter 1'' with the suffix ''(medium)''. Multiple sets allowed, seperated with comma. ;heavy :Heavy armor set page, default is ''parameter 1'' with the suffix ''(heavy)''. Multiple sets allowed, seperated with comma. ;level :Level (e.g. 80) and/or level range (seperated with - and/or , e.g. 50-80 or 50, 60 or 0,50-80). Default is level 80. For skins use ''no''. ;rarity :Rarity, seperated with a comma. Default is {{rarity|Exotic}}. ;release :Release, either: ''core'' (default), ''hot'' or ''pof''. ;filters :Acquisition methods. == Example ==

{{{title|}}}

{{{text|}}}
 For use on Living World summary pages. == Usage == 
{{Living World character
 | title = [[|]]
 | text = 
}}
=== Parameters === ;title :Wikilink to NPC page. This gets wrapped in a === header === and appears in the table of contents. ;text :Main body description of NPC. ;last :Optional. Use if this is the last occurence of this template on the page. This suppresses the border below the text block. Set equal to anything to suppress the border. == Example == 
{{Living World character
 | title = [[Rox|Rox Whetstone]]
 | text = Rox has skilfully handled every challenge set for her so far by her half-brother [[Rytlock Brimstone|Tribune Brimstone]] in her trials to join his legendary [[warband]]—almost. She retook the [[North Nolan Hatchery]] from the Molten Alliance, where she met her new animal companion, [[Frostbite]]. At the [[Queen's Jubilee]], she served as the official delegation to [[Divinity's Reach]] from the [[Black Citadel]] in Rytlock's stead, and defended the [[human]] city when it came under attack by Scarlet. She fought alongside the [[Vigil]] and a small army to take down [[Tequatl the Sunless]]. Her final test was to take down Scarlet Briar, but when the opportunity arose, Rox instead chose to tend to and defend the wounded Braham and Marjory, allowing Kasmeer Meade the pleasure of the kill. Now, she has gone into hiding in [[Divinity's Reach]], avoiding her Tribune's summons. Technically, he's within his rights to gut her on the spot for insubordination. But Rox doesn't ''want'' in anymore—she's found her own warband now.
}}
{{Living World character | title = [[Rox|Rox Whetstone]] | text = Rox has skilfully handled every challenge set for her so far by her half-brother [[Rytlock Brimstone|Tribune Brimstone]] in her trials to join his legendary [[warband]]—almost. She retook the [[North Nolan Hatchery]] from the Molten Alliance, where she met her new animal companion, [[Frostbite]]. At the [[Queen's Jubilee]], she served as the official delegation to [[Divinity's Reach]] from the [[Black Citadel]] in Rytlock's stead, and defended the [[human]] city when it came under attack by Scarlet. She fought alongside the [[Vigil]] and a small army to take down [[Tequatl the Sunless]]. Now, she has gone into hiding in [[Divinity's Reach]], avoiding her Tribune's summons. Technically, he's within his rights to gut her on the spot for insubordination. | next =

=== Parameters === ; name : Optional. Name of the event if the page name is not the same. Defaults to the page name. ; chapter : Required. Categorizes the living story and links to the living story chapter. ; year : Optional. The year in the [[Mouvelian calendar]] when this event happens. ; location : Required. The locations in which the event takes place. This is usually a comma separated list. ; level : Optional. The level of this event. ; prev : Optional. The name of the first previous event. ; next : Optional. The name of the first following event. ; map1 : The name of the file (without the File: tag). ; map1-text : The text that goes under map1. ; map2, map3, map4, map5, map2-text, map3-text, map4-text, map5-text : Same as above. ; loading screen1 : The name of the file (without the File: tag). ; loading screen1-text : The text that goes under loading screen1. ; loading screen2, loading screen3 : Same as above. ; categorize : Optional. "y" or "n" to turn on/off categorization. Default is on for main namespace articles and off for others. If using "status", don't set this parameter. ; status : Optional. Status of content. Only set if not currently obtainable ingame, displays relevant notice. Available options: "historical", "future", "unimplemented", "current" (default). ; status notes : Optional. Allows provision of additional reason for the given status. ; status date : Optional. Sets the date of the update that marked this skill as historical (in YYYY-MM-DD format). ; requires : Optional. The expansion or living world season required to access the content. Displays a notice of the release. See {{tl|infobox requires}} for options. == See also == * [[Template:Story infobox]] [[Category:Infobox templates|Living world]] [[Category:Deprecated templates]]

}} }} {{!}}- {{!}} {{#tag: imagemap| File:{{#var: floor image {{#var:N}}}}{{!}}200x180px @@@ desc none }}{{#vardefine: N|{{#expr: {{#var:N}}+1}}}} |\n}} |} == Description == Provides the logic for, and should only be used indirectly via, "Locators/<"within"-parameter value of the {{[[Template:Location infobox|location infobox]]}}; as found on the area pages/map (page) name>"-subtemplates. == Usage == 
{{locators||}}
{{locators|||caption=}}
{{locators|||locator=}}
{{locators|||page=}}
=== Parameters === ; 1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : One or more lines of area to bound information definitions. Area to bound information definitions consist of the following two parts, in that order, separated with a tilde: :# The page name of the area. :# The bound information applicable to the area. The bound information should be of polygonal nature and must be of the form as would be specified in the "imagemap"-element. Refer to [[mw:Extension:ImageMap#Syntax description]] for a description of the syntax. ; 2 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : One or more lines of floor definitions. Floor definitions consist of the following three parts, in that order, separated with a tilde: :# The page names of the areas part of this floor. Multiple values must be separated with a semicolon. These values are what will be compared against the values passed to unnamed parameter one in order to determine the bound information for the area. :# Optional. The label for the floor. E.g. "Sky", "Ground", "Depths", etc. Multiple values must be separated with a semicolon. Should not be specified for maps where all of the areas are the same across all of the floors. :# Optional. The name of the file (without the namespace) for the image to show for the floor when the curent page does not describe any area on the floor, i.e. an image of the floor without any area highlighted. This may but should not be specified when this cannot occur; as would be the case for maps where all of the areas are the same across all of the floors. ; caption : Optional. The text to display below all of the floor images. ; locator : Optional. The name of the locator image for the area (without the namespace). Defaults to <"page"-parameter value> locator.svg. ; page : Optional. The name of the area page. Defaults to {{PAGENAME}}. === Example === ; [[Template:Locators/Bloodstone Fen|/Bloodstone Fen]] {{#urldecode:%3C}}includeonly>{{#urldecode:%7B%7B}}locators| poly 152.44 97.13 67.72 106.75 67.72 962.59 439.84 996.31 455.28 595 401.97 486.22 474.59 375.41 742.47 306.97 742.47 306.97 628.16 550.72 455.28 595 439.84 996.31 1566.28 996.31 1947.63 949.25 1947.63 299.88 1839.13 97.13 152.44 97.13 152.44 97.13 [[Fragmented Wastes]] poly 455.29 595 401.96 486.2 474.59 375.42 742.48 306.97 628.14 550.71 455.29 595 [[Pride of the Pact]] --- poly 930.35 611.29 1106.31 97.13 1839.13 97.13 1947.63 299.88 1947.63 949.25 1566.28 996.31 1142.87 996.31 930.35 611.29 [[Bloodstone Maw]] poly 67.72 106.75 152.44 97.13 1106.31 97.13 930.35 611.29 1142.87 996.31 439.84 996.31 67.72 962.59 67.72 106.75 [[Haunted Canyons]] --- poly 930.35 611.29 1106.31 97.13 1839.13 97.13 1947.63 299.88 1947.63 949.25 1566.28 996.31 1142.87 996.31 930.35 611.29 [[Bloodstone Maw]] poly 67.72 106.75 152.44 97.13 1106.31 97.13 930.35 611.29 1142.87 996.31 439.84 996.31 67.72 962.59 67.72 106.75 [[Cavern of Unseen Lights]] | Sky ~ Bloodstone Fen area outlines (Sky).svg Ground ~ Bloodstone Fen area outlines (Ground & Depths).svg Depths ~ Bloodstone Fen area outlines (Ground & Depths).svg |caption={{{caption|}}}|locator={{{locator|}}}|page={{{page|}}}}}{{#urldecode:%3C}}/includeonly>{{#urldecode:%3C}}noinclude> {{#urldecode:%7B%7B}}locators/preview| Bloodstone Maw Cavern of Unseen Lights Fragmented Wastes Haunted Canyons Pride of the Pact }} {{#urldecode:%3C}}/noinclude> {{locators/preview| Bloodstone Maw Cavern of Unseen Lights Fragmented Wastes Haunted Canyons Pride of the Pact |template=Locators/Bloodstone Fen|locator text=Bloodstone Fen}} == See also == * [[Special:PrefixIndex/Template:Locators/]] * [[Template:Locators/preview]] * [[Widget:Locators]] [[Category:Map templates]]

}}[https://api.guildwars2.com/v2/items?ids={{#replace:{{{id}}}&lang=en| |}} API] }} {{#subobject:item{{#var:itemcnt}} | Has game id ={{{id|}}} | Has canonical name ={{{name|}}} | Has context=Item | Has game icon ={{#var:game_icon}} | Has equipment supertype={{#var:supertype}} | Has item type={{ucfirst:{{#var:type_ori}}}} | Has armor type ={{#ifeq:{{#var:supertype}}|armor|{{ucfirst:{{#var:type_ori}}}}}} | Has weapon type={{#ifeq:{{#var:supertype}}|weapon|{{ucfirst:{{#var:type_std}}}}}} | Has trinket type={{#ifeq:{{#var:supertype}}|trinket|{{ucfirst:{{#var:type_std}}}}}} | Has armor set ={{ucfirst:{{#var:armor_set}}}} | Has armor weight class ={{ucfirst:{{#var:armor_weight{{#var:skin class}}}}}} | Has defense ={{#var:defense}} | Has weapon strength ={{#ifeq:A{{#var:min strength}}; {{#var:max strength}}A|A; A||{{#var:min strength}}; {{#var:max strength}}}} | Has item rarity ={{ucfirst:{{#var:lvt_rarity|{{#var:rarity_std}}}}}} | Has level requirement ={{{level}}} | Has equipment prefix ={{lc:{{{prefix|}}}}} | Has upgrade component ={{{uslot|}}} | Has vendor value ={{{value|}}} | Is historical={{{historical|{{#var: historical|{{#vardefineecho: historical|{{#show: {{PAGENAME}}|?Is historical|default=N}}}}}}}}} | Has availability={{#if: {{{status|}}} | {{ucfirst:{{{status}}}}} | {{#ifeq: {{lc:{{{historical|n}}}}} | y | Historical | {{#var: availability|{{#vardefineecho: availability|{{#show:{{PAGENAME}}|?Has availability|default=Current}}}}}} }} }} | Is tradable={{#ifeq:{{#var:lvt_bound}}|y|N|{{#var:tradable|Y}}}} }} == Usage == This template, in conjuction with {{tl|Loot variant table header}} and {{tl|Loot variant table subheader}}, produces a table designed to document all the variants of items dropped as [[loot]] that share the same name and skin. It relies on a partially filled out {{tl|Armor infobox}}, {{tl|Trinket infobox}}, or {{tl|Weapon infobox}} to define the general properties of all variants. This table creates a subobject for each item in the table, allowing for searching via chat links and [[GW2W:SMW|SMW queries]]. Properties not defined in this template are copied from the infobox. == Parameters == === Header === All parameters are optional. Parameters set here are applied to all variants in the table or used to set the formatting of the overall table. 
{{loot variant table header | expanded = n | nosell = n | bound = n | boost = | type =  }}
; expanded : Set to ''y'' to make the table non-collapsible; otherwise, the table will be collapsed initially. If the table has subheaders, they will override this setting. ; nosell : Set to ''y'' if all variants cannot be sold to vendors. This will hide the "Value" column. ; bound : Set to ''y'' if all variants are [[binding|bound]] on acquire. This will hide the external links to trading post tracking sites. ; boost : Specifies the difference between the required level and the stat level of [[leveling equipment]]. ; type : Armor piece or weapon type. === Subheader === 
{{loot variant table subheader |  }}
;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : '''Required.''' Specified the rarity shared by all variants in the following section of the table. === Row === These parameters define the specific properties of each variant.

== Description == In-game mail styling for documenting mailbox mail. === Usage === 
{{Mail
| sender = 
| subject = 
| content = 
| sign =
| reward = 
}}
=== Parameters === ; sender : Required. Name of the sender NPC, will be displayed in bold. Input   if a blank entry is required. ; subject : Required. The subject or title of the mail. Input   if a blank entry is required. ; content : Required. The content body of the mail. Use
to break the text into multiple paragraphs as needed. Input   if a blank entry is required. ; sign : Optional. The name or sentence that is displayed at the bottom of the in-game mail, after a dash. Defaults to "sender". ; nosign : Optional. Set to "y" to hide the signature. ; ps : Optional. Any message content after the signature. ; reward : Optional. The monetary reward or items attached to the mail, if any. ; float : Optional. If set to right, the mail will appear at the right-hand side of the page with appropriately adjusted margins. ; pointer ... pointer2 : Optional. Location where the mail directs the player to. If it is a POI or NPC, this template will display an interactive map of the location (if their coordinate is set on their page). If it is a waypoint, will display a waypoint link. Can separate multiple values with a comma. ; pointer text ... pointer2 text : Optional. Description of location where the mail directs the player to. ; pointer coordinates ... pointer2 coordinates : Optional. Overrides the coordinates obtained by SMW for the given pointer. ; pointer icon ... pointer2 icon : Optional. Specific the "pointer coordinates" icon. ; icon : Optional. The icon used for this mail. Defaults to [[File:Mail.png|30px]] but one of the following inputs can be specified: :{| {{STDT}} ! Input !! Icon |- | heart
map completion || [[File:Complete heart (map icon).png|30px]] |- | story || [[File:Storyline (interface).png|30px]] |- | arenanet || [[File:ArenaNet tag.png|30px]] |- | gem store || [[File:Gem Store mail purchase.png|30px]] |- | gem store gift || [[File:Gem Store mail gift.png|30px]] |- | dungeon
fractal || [[File:Dungeon (map icon).png|30px]] |- | raid || [[File:Raid (map icon).png|30px]] |- | birthday || [[File:Birthday Gift.png|30px]] |- | || 30px icon |} === Examples === 
{{Mail
| icon = birthday
| sender = The Guild Wars 2 Team
| subject = Happy Birthday, !
| content = Congratulations! It's the anniversary of your character's creation, and in recognition of your last year of heroic deeds in Tyria, here is a gift from us to you. Thanks for playing Guild Wars 2!
| reward = {{item icon|Third Birthday Gift}}
| nosign = y
}}
{{Mail | icon = birthday | sender = The Guild Wars 2 Team | subject = Happy Birthday, ! | content = Congratulations! It's the anniversary of your character's creation, and in recognition of your last year of heroic deeds in Tyria, here is a gift from us to you. Thanks for playing Guild Wars 2! | reward = {{item icon|Third Birthday Gift}} | nosign = y }} 
{{Mail
| sender = Toymaker Tixx
| subject = A Special Gift
| content = As a token of my appreciation for Tyria's generosity in allowing me to showcase my work, and for the assistance I've received from it's helpful citizens, I have mailed this special gift to every citizen of Tyria.

Wishing you a warm and wound-up Wintersday,
| sign = [[Toymaker Tixx]]
| reward = {{item icon|Toymaker Tixx's Gift}}
| pointer = Crown Pavilion Waypoint
| pointer text = Join the festivities.
}}

Current release: “[[The Only Way]]”

[[File:The Only Way banner.jpg|550px|link=The Only Way]]
[[File:The Only Way banner.jpg|550px|link=The Only Way]]
The launch story for [[Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity]] had players investigating a series of secretive [[Inquest]] voyages to the fabled island of [[Castora]], a mysterious area rich with [[Ley line|ley]] [[magic]]. Ancient secrets were unearthed. The [[Seneschal|island’s guardians]] were overcome. And the story now picks up with the [[Pact Commander|Commander]] tasked with stopping [[Vloxx]], the newly-elevated Inquest leader who thinks his machinations are for the good of [[Tyria]]. The next five chapters of the story in this update bring the Commander to the new map of [[Eternity's Garden]]. To accompany the story, this release also brings new and updated features. Two new mastery tiers add new account-wide horizontal progression for players. [[Relics—Visions of Eternity Set 3|Six new earnable expansion]] [[relic]]s bring new combat-augmenting effects to character builds. New [[Legendary trinket|legendary accessories]], one earned through PvE content and one from [[World vs. World]] multiplayer, are available for acquisition. And more elements of players' look can now be managed through the [[Fashion Template]] feature released in February 2026. A refreshed set of [[Wizard's Vault]] objectives, an earnable raptor mount skin, as well as a host of other rewards associated with the new map and content, round out the release. ;[[The Only Way|LEARN MORE]]

Gasp }} }}</includeonly><noinclude>A data lookup template to help figure out [[Map bonus reward]]s.
== Usage == <pre>{{Map bonus reward data|zone=<zone name>|week=<week number>|points=<points>}}</pre>
* Weeks range from 1 to 8 for core maps and 1 to 6 for Heart of Thorns maps. All other maps do not have weekly changing map bonus rewards. * Points range from 200 to 8000 for core maps. Other maps use different point thresholds.
Data is returned in the format <code><nowiki>item_qty:item_name</nowiki></code>.
== Example == <pre>{{Map bonus reward data|zone=Gendarran Fields|week=3|points=200}}</pre> {{Map bonus reward data|zone=Gendarran Fields|week=3|points=200}} [[Category:Data templates]] </noinclude>

== Usage == === Input variables === The variable "type" can be set on the page like {{#vardefine:type|Point of Interest}} (where the desired icon replaces "Point of Interest", e.g. "Waypoint"), and setting one or the other will result in the formatting of an icon preceding the location link. Subobjects by default are not stored. To enable subobjects on a page, add {{#vardefine:store subobjects|true}} to the top of it. === Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' :id ;2 ''(unnamed parameter)'' :canonical location name ;page :Name of location's article, if different from canonical name. Template will query the canonical name from this page, so it is not necessary to give both this parameter and unnamed parameter 2. ;historical :Optional. Set to y if historical. ;subobject index :Optional. Use if duplicate names on the same page. [[Category:Subobject templates]] [[Category:Chat link format page templates]]

| headers = hide | intro = ( | outro = ) }} | heart = {{#ask: [[{{{2}}}]] | ?Has heart level | mainlabel = - | headers = hide | intro = ( | outro = ) }} }}{{#if: {{NAMESPACE}} || {{#if: {{{2|}}} || [[Category:Pages with incorrect template usage]] }} {{#ifexist: {{PAGENAME}} | {{#if: {{#show: {{PAGENAME}} | ?Has location type | link = none |@annotation}} | {{#switch: {{lc:{{{1}}}}} | waypoint | vista = {{#subobject:{{{2}}}{{{subobject index|}}} | Has canonical name ={{{2}}} | Has game id ={{{id|}}} | Has location type ={{ucfirst:{{{1}}}}} | Located in ={{#titleparts:{{PAGENAME}}}} | Has context =Location | Is historical ={{#switch:{{{status|}}} | unimplemented = Y | future = Y | historical = Y | discontinued = N | temporary = Y | temporary item = N | current | #default = N }} | Has availability ={{#switch:{{{status|}}} | unimplemented = Unimplemented | future = Future | historical = Historical | discontinued = Discontinued | temporary = Historical | temporary item = Discontinued | current | #default = Current }} }} }} | [[Category:Pages with incorrect template usage]] [[Template:Map objective#Description|Usage note]] }} }} }}__NOTOC__ == Description == Defines a map objective. This template is used on [[Property:Has location type|location]] pages to list map objectives in the location, and to define the SMW properties for those objectives. The output is an icon, link (if appropriate) and a chat link (if an ID is defined). If an insufficient number of parameters have been provided, then the page is added to [[:Category:Pages with incorrect template usage]]. This template is for ''defining'' map objectives, and should generally only be used in the Locations and Objects section of location pages. If you're writing something that needs to link ''to'' a map objective (e.g. in a Getting there section), use {{tl|waypoint}}, {{tl|point of interest}} or manual formatting with {{tl|map icon}}. A small "usage note" link will be added to the end of the template display if it's used on a page without [[Property:Has location type]] set, pointing editors to this documentation page. == Usage == 
{{map objective||}}
=== Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' :Required. Type of location. Options: :: heart :: waypoint :: asura gate :: point of interest :: hero challenge :: vista :: jumping puzzle ;2 ''(unnamed parameter)'' :Required. Name of the objective. ;3 ''(unnamed parameter)'' :Optional. Display name of the objective. ;id :Optional. If given, shows the chat link to the objective. Should only be used for waypoints, vistas, and points of interest. ;sep :Optional. Replaces the default separator of —  ;status :Optional. The status of the objective. See [[Template:Infobox status]] for allowed values and their meaning. ;subobject index :Optional. Only use if two identically named waypoints exist on the same page. === Example === Note: if the page exists and has game id set on it, this template will look up the chatlink. 
:{{map objective|point of interest|Posternus Caverns}}
:{{map objective|point of interest|Posternus Caverns}} 
:{{map objective|point of interest|Posternus Caverns|id=1628}}
:{{map objective|point of interest|Posternus Caverns|id=1628}} [[Category:Location formatting templates]] [[Category:Subobject templates]]

=== Parameters === ; name : Optional. Mastery name. Defaults to the page name. ; points : Required. The number of mastery points required to use the mastery. ; experience : Required. The amount of experience required to acquire the mastery. ; region : Required. The region that the track is unlocked in. (e.g. "Heart of Maguuma") ; track : Required. The mastery track that the specific mastery is under. (e.g. "Gliding") ; tier : Required. The mastery track tier. ; description : Required. The in-game description. ; mastered description : Optional. The in-game description of the mastery once it's been mastered. ; categorize : Optional. "y" or "n" to turn on/off categorization. Default is on for main namespace articles and off for others. If using "status", don't set this parameter. ; status : Optional. Status of content. Only set if not currently obtainable ingame, displays relevant notice. Available options: "historical", "future", "unimplemented", "current" (default). ; status notes : Optional. Allows provision of additional reason for the given status. ; status date : Optional. Sets the date of the update that marked this skill as historical (in YYYY-MM-DD format). ; requires : Optional. The expansion or living world season required to access the content. Displays a notice of the release. See {{tl|infobox requires}} for options. === Example === 
{{Mastery infobox
| points = 1
| xp = 508000
| region = Heart of Thorns
| track = Gliding
| tier = 1
| description = Gain access to the glider so that you can glide like a squirrel across the highest points of the Heart of Maguuma.
| mastered description = To glide, jump from a high place, and then press the jump key again while falling.
| requires = hot
}}
{{Mastery infobox | name = Glider Basics | icon = Glider Basics.png | points = 2 | xp = 1016000 | region = Heart of Thorns | track = Gliding | tier = 2 | description = Improved design to your glider handles and slits in the wings let you confidently fly into updrafts, allowing you to gain altitude and travel to previously unreachable locations. | mastered description = Updrafts are pillars of swirling wind found around the [[Heart of Maguuma|Maguuma Jungle]]. To use updrafts, simply glide into them and receive an elevation boost. | requires = hot }} [[Category:Infobox templates]]

 == Description == This template displays the mount or mastery unlock text. == Usage == 
{{Mastery unlock text
| image  = 
| title  = 
| text   =
| icon1  =
| text1  =
}}
=== Parameters === ;header : Optional. Header text ;mastery : Mastery name. (set if image and title are identical from the default format below) ;image : Optional. Set a custom image. Default to banner.png. Set to "none" to disable the image. ;title : Optional. Default to Mastery ;text : Required. Unlock text. ;icon1...5 : Optional. Default to Mastery unlock icon.png ;text1...5 : Optional. Unlock text after icon. ;ps : Optional. Italic note outside the box. ;height : Optional. Box height to provide a consistent format if they are next to each other. ;float : Optional. If set to right, the box will appear at the right-hand side of the page with appropriately adjusted margins. === Examples === See: [[Raptor]], [[Skyscale]] 
{{Mastery unlock text
| header = Mount Trial Active
| image  = Raptor banner.png
| title  = The Raptor
| text   = Road test the raptor! For the next 10 hours of gameplay, you can explore [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]] with the help of your trial mount. Upgrade your account by purchasing an [[expansion]] to permanently unlock this mount.
| icon1  = Raptor (item).png
| text1  = Use the raptor's high-speed running, [[Leap (Raptor)|long jumps]], and [[Tail Spin|tail spin]] skills to help you along your journey through Tyria.
| icon2  = Mastery unlock icon.png
| text2  = To further train the raptor's mobility and combat skills, accounts must have the [[Path of Fire]] expansion unlocked.
| ps = [[Mount Trial Active|Mount trial activation pop-up]]
}}

Defaults to the current date. :{| class="wikitable" ! Format ! Example |- | yyyy-mm-dd | 2018-11-26 |- | mm/dd/yyyy | 11/26/2018 |- | dd (month name) yyyy | 26 Nov 2018 |- | (month name) dd, yyyy | November 26, 2018 |} ;display :Optional. Forces the template to display a section of the date rather than the entire string. Possible values are day, season, year, day-season, and season-year. === Examples === 
Today is {{Mouvelian}}.

''"Lion's Arch was invaded on {{Mouvelian|18 February 2014}}, and liberated on {{Mouvelian|04 Mar 2014|display=day-season}} of that same year."''

translate between mouvelian and gregorian dates. == Usage == 
{{mouvelian calendar||}}
=== Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Rules to build the calendar from in the form of : , separated by newlines, where actions may be any one of the following: :* first day of next season - Indicates that this gregorian date is the start of the next mouvelian season. Due to the calendar automatically starting with Zephyr, this need only be specified three times. :* same date as previous day - Indicates that this gregorian date has the same mouvelian date as the day before it. This is intended for use with February 29 in leap years. :* n/a - Indicates that this gregorian date does not apply to the mouvelian calendar. This is intended for use with February 29 in common years. ;2 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Same as for unnamed parameter no. 1; but for leap years. === Example === This example produces a calendar that places the five days at the end of the year. 
{{mouvelian calendar|
February 29: n/a
April 1: first day of next season
June 30: first day of next season
September 28: first day of next season
|
March 31: first day of next season
June 29: first day of next season
September 27: first day of next season
}}

== Parameters == ; name : Item name. Defaults to the page name. ; generic : Optional. Set result to yes if the result of the recipe is something generic. Setting this parameter removes the link from the name parameter. ; link : Use if recipe name =/= page name for linking ; icon : Icon, if not present, checks for existence of {{{name}}}.png. If true, set to that, otherwise, Skill.jpg ; quantity : Number of items created by the recipe. ; desc1 (desc2, desc3, desc4, desc5, desc6) : Unique Descriptions ; mat-1 (mat-2, mat-3, mat-4) : Crafting material #1. ; amt-1 (amt-2, amt-3, amt-4) : The amount of materials required. ; genmat-1 (genmat-2, genmat-3, genmat-4) : Set result to yes if the material required is generic. This will cause the template to use a locked skill icon. Otherwise leave blank. == Example == {{mystic recipe | name = Item | desc1 = +7 Power

=== Parameters === ;image : The image used for the section in My Story. Defaults to {{PAGENAME}}.jpg. Don't bother specifying this parameter if the image name is the same as the page name. ;text : The main text of the My Story page. === Example === 
{{mystory
| image = Breaking the Bone Ship.jpg
| text = Tonn's skill and bravery allowed us to sink the bone ship, but it cost him his life. When a mechanical failure prevented the charges from detonating, Tonn put himself at risk to make sure they went off. He succeeded, but was unable to get clear of the blast. His sacrifice saved hundreds of lives, but that won't be much comfort to his friends, his family, or those of us who fought beside him.
}}

File:{{#if:{{{image|}}}|{{{image}}}|{{#replace:{{BASEPAGENAME}}|:|-}}.jpg}}| | [[Category:NPCs missing a screenshot]] }} }} }} == Usage == 
{{NPC infobox
| name = 
| image = 
| random = 
| variable = 
| location = 
| coordinates = 
| race = 
| mechanical race = 
| organization = 
| level = 
| rank = 
| profession = 
| service = 
| goal = 
| gallery1...gallery5 = 
| gallery1-text...gallery5-text = 
| requires = 
| status = 
| status notes = 
}}
=== Parameters === ; name : Optional. Only include if the name of the NPC differs from the article name. Defaults the name of the article: {{PAGENAME}}. ; icon : Optional. Only include if the NPC has a unique icon. If no value is set the icon defaults to showing an icon chosen by the '''service''' parameter. If that too is unspecified, the icon is hidden. If set to no or none, this parameter can suppress default icons caused by specification of the service parameter. ;overhead icon : Optional. Overhead icon, display icon on the top right corner, but does not affect the infobox map. ;map icon : Optional. The infobox map icon, only affects the infobox map. ; image : Optional. Defaults to the page name: {{PAGENAME}}.jpg. Set to no to disable the image. Note that the NPC screenshot should not include any text. The [[Guild Wars 2 Wiki:Projects/Shared Model Project|Shared Model Project]] might be used for any already uploaded model. ; random : Optional. Set to yes if the NPC's appearance changes randomly. Commonly used for many generic NPCs and merchants. Defaults to no. ; variable: Optional. Set to yes if the NPC's appearance changes based on player choices like story or character customization. Defaults to no. ; location : Required. The area(s) or zone(s) the NPC can be found. Use a semi-colon separated list of locations. ; coordinates / path / bounds : Optional. Inherited from [[Template:Infobox map]]. The X and Y coordinates to the NPCs location. Displays and interactive map with a marker of the NPC's location. EG [12345,31321]. See {{tl|Infobox map}} for more details. ; waypoint id : Optional. Inherited from [[Template:Infobox map]]. The waypoint map id to be shown in the infobox map, defaults to showing the nearest waypoint on the same floor by distance. ; race : Required. The race of the NPC. Race here should be capitalized. If this NPC could be multiple races, either list them all, comma-separated, or use "Various" instead of a huge list. For objects that are coded as NPCs in order to perform certain functions, use "object". ; mechanical race: Optional. The [[mechanical race]] of the NPC, if it's different from their lore race, e.g. raid bosses. ; organization : Optional. The organization/affiliation the NPC belongs to. ; level : Optional. The level or levels of the NPC. ; rank : Optional. Should be one of the following: veteran, elite, champion, legendary or epic. For NPCs that cannot be targeted, use no or none. Defaults to normal. Use a comma-separated list if more than one rank is possible. ; profession : Optional. The profession of the NPC. Use a comma-separated list if more than one profession is possible. ; service : The [[service]] or services provided by the NPC. Use a comma-separated list of services. Options: :: adventure :: armorsmith :: reinforce armor :: bandit crest collector :: collections instructor :: dungeon information :: dungeon merchant :: fishmonger :: fishing supplies :: gift :: guild commendation trader :: guild promoter :: guild armorer :: guild weaponsmith :: weaponsmith :: karma :: ley line crystal merchant :: cultural armorsmith :: cultural weaponsmith :: master armorsmith :: master artificer :: master chef :: master huntsman :: master jeweler :: master leatherworker :: master scribe :: master tailor :: master weaponsmith :: merchant :: race organizer :: repairs :: renown heart :: repeatable heart :: skill challenge :: hero challenge :: trading post :: transport facilitator :: living world :: living story :: living story scout :: living story waypoint :: living story collector :: living world merchant :: geode merchant :: belcher's bluff :: activity :: mystic forge attendant :: guild claiming :: guild :: proprietor :: mastery insight (path of fire) :: mastery insight (end of dragons) :: dragon arena ; goal : Optional. Specific hero challenge events or Renown Heart tasks this NPC is affiliated with. If entering multiple goals, put each new goal on a new line. ; gallery1 ... gallery5 : Optional. Images related to the NPC. The first image defaults to {{PAGENAME}} location.jpg. ; gallery1-text ... gallery5-text : Optional. Image descriptions. ; categorize : Optional. "y" or "n" to turn on/off categorization. Default is on for main namespace articles and off for others. If using "status", don't set this parameter. ; status : Optional. Status of content. Only set if not currently obtainable ingame, displays relevant notice. Available options: "historical", "future", and "unimplemented". ; status notes : Optional. Allows provision of additional reason for the given status. ; status date : Optional. Sets the date of the update that marked this skill as historical (in YYYY-MM-DD format). ; requires : Optional. The expansion or living world season required to access the content. Displays a notice of the required release. See {{tl|infobox requires}} for options. === Example === 
{{NPC infobox
| image = Caithe 02 concept art.jpg
| location = Maguuma Jungle; The Grove; Divinity's Reach
| race = Sylvari
| mechanical race = plant
| organization = Destiny's Edge
| level = 80
| rank = Legendary
| profession = Thief
| service = Guild Armorer
| gallery1 = User Lucian Shadowborn map.jpg
| gallery1-text = Location in Magumma Jungle
| gallery2 = User Lucian Shadowborn map.jpg
| gallery2-text = Location in The Grove
| gallery3 = User Lucian Shadowborn map.jpg
| gallery3-text = Location in Divinity's Reach
}}

This template isn't used, retained for historical benefit when using the History function on certain pages.}} == Description == This template is used on [[Area]] pages to set the location of a [[NPC]]. Creates a subobject ([[Property:Has context|context]]: ''NPC location'') and sets the properties [[Property:Location of|Location of]], [[Property:Has NPC level|Has NPC level]] and [[Property:Has notes|Has notes]]. == Usage == 
{{NPC location|}}
{{NPC location|||icon=|level=|notes=}}
{{NPC location||icon=misc|icon2=|icon3=}}
=== Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Required, NPC name. ;2 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Optional. Displayed NPC name. ;icon : Optional, vendor or crafter type icon, uses the template {{tl|vendor}} or {{tl|crafter}}. ;level : Optional, NPC level. ;notes : Optional, NPC notes, e.g. "During night only". ;icon2 : Optional. The name of an icon file without File: prefix. Will be ignored, unless icon is set to misc. ;icon3 : Optional. A page name that the icon should link to. Will be ignored, unless the icon is set to misc. == See also == * {{tl|NPC location list}} [[Category:Deprecated templates]]

{{NPC service list|}}
== Parameters == ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Query term. Defaults to {{PAGENAME}}. ;historical : Optional. If set to anything, includes historical NPCs. Set to ''only'' for only historical content. == Examples == 
{{NPC service list|Master chef}}
{{NPC service list|Master chef}} == See also == * {{tl|NPC service table}} [[es:Plantilla:Lista de vendedores servicios]] [[Category:List formatting templates]]

    • |\n}}
}} This template is for simple lists where you wish to display the location of the entity. This assumes the entity has a [[Property:Located in]] and the location is an [[area]] or equivalent. #Page #Located in Rather than using this template directly, you probably want to use {{tl|NPC service list}} instead. Format using {{tl|NPC service table header}} and {{tl|NPC service table result format}}. 
{{NPC service table|}}
== Parameters == ;Unnamed parameter 1 : Query term. Defaults to {{PAGENAME}}. ;category : Optional. Filters for NPCs in the category. ;historical : Optional. If set to anything, includes historical NPCs. Set to ''only'' for only historical content. ;scheme : Optional. Color scheme, default is ''crafting'' for pages in the category [[:Category: Crafting professions]], otherwise ''pve''. ;limit : Optional. Default is 250. == Examples ==

{{#ifeq: {{NAMESPACE}} | {{ns:Template}} | [[Category:{{{template category|Navigation templates}}}]] | {{#if: {{{category|}}} | {{#ifeq: {{NAMESPACE}} | {{ns:0}} | [[Category:{{{category}}}]] }} }} }} == Usage == This templates can be used to create a navbox with arbitrary content. While it can be used on any article page, the main purpose of this template is to simplify the creation of more specific [[:Category:Navigation templates|navigation templates]]. 
{{nav | title =  | <content> }}
</pre>

If only a list of quick links is required, {{tl|blank nav}} might be the better choice.

== Parameters ==
; 1 ''(unnamed parameter)''
: Required. The content of the navbox.
; title
: Required. Title of the navbox.
; class
: Optional. The table color class. See [[Template:STDT#Color examples]] for a list. Defaults to <code>mech1</code>.
; category
: Optional. Category that will only be used when this template is transcluded on a [[mw:Help:Namespaces#(Main)|mainspace]] page. Doesn't set any category by default.
; template category
: Optional. Category that will only be used when this template is transcluded on another template page. Defaults to [[:Category:Navigation templates|Navigation templates]].

== Example ==
<pre>
{{nav
| title = [[Dolyak]]s
| class = ranger
|
; Generic : {{hlist|[[Dolyak (NPC)|Dolyak]], [[Festive Dolyak]], [[Pack Dolyak]]}}
; Named : {{hlist|[[Emma]], [[Ramsy]], [[Titan]]}}
}}
</pre>

|
; Generic : {{hlist|[[Dolyak (NPC)|Dolyak]], [[Festive Dolyak]], [[Pack Dolyak]]}}

}}

eternity) = {{#set: | Has mastery id = {{{id|-999}}} }} }} }} {{clear}} == Description == This infobox is used for [[object]]s in the game world. == Usage == 
{{Object infobox
| name = 
| icon = 
| image = 
| location = 
| type = 
| req = 
| gives = 
| goal = 
| interact = 
| destruct = 
| interaction prompt = 
| gallery1...gallery5 = 
| gallery1-text...gallery5-text = 
| requires = 
| status = 
}}
=== Parameters === ;name : Optional. Defaults the name of the article ({{PAGENAME}}). ;icon : Optional. Map icon of object, displays icon on the top right corner and the infobox map. Parameter sets [[Property:Has game icon]]. ;overhead icon : Optional. Overhead icon, display icon on the top right corner, but does not affect the infobox map. ;map icon : Optional. The infobox map icon, only affects the infobox map. ;image : Optional. The interactive object image should not include any text. Defaults to the page name ({{PAGENAME}}.jpg). ;location : Required. The area or areas that the object can be found in. Use a semi-colon separated list. ;coordinates / path : Optional. The X and Y coordinates for the location. Displays an interactive map with a marker at the given location. e.g. [12345, 31321]. See [[Template:Infobox map]] for details on how to capture coordinates. ;type : Optional. Specify the type of object. ::Book ::Chest ::Crafting station ::Bundle ::Gravestone ::mastery insight (Central Tyria) ::mastery insight (Heart of Thorns) ::mastery insight (Path of Fire) ::mastery insight (Icebrood Saga) ::mastery insight (End of Dragons) ::mastery insight (Secrets of the Obscure) ::mastery insight (Janthir Wilds) ::mastery insight (Visions of Eternity) ::Mine ::Tree ::Plant ::Resource node ::Hero challenge ::Siege weapon ::Static weapon ::Statue ;resource type : Optional. If "type" is set to "Resource node", setting the "resource type" parameter sets [[Property:Has gathering node type]]. ;summon : Optional. The source of the object. ;goal : Optional. Specific any events or tasks this object is affiliated with. ;interact : Optional. If the object can be interacted with. Defaults to ''y''. ;interaction prompt : Optional. The text of the interaction prompt shown. ;destruct : Optional. If the object can be destroyed and therefore has a health bar. Defaults to ''n''. ;req : Optional. Specify any requirements for interacting with the object (mostly nodes). ;gives : Optional. Specify any item/items resulting from interacting with the object. Use a comma-separated list of values. ;gallery1 : Optional. Image related to the object. Defaults to {{PAGENAME}} location.jpg. ;gallery2 ... gallery5 : Optional. Images related to the object. ;gallery1-text ... gallery5-text : Optional. Image descriptions. ;categorize : Optional. "y" or "n" to turn on/off categorization. Default is on for main namespace articles and off for others. If using "status", don't set this parameter. ;status : Optional. Status of content. Only set if not currently obtainable ingame, displays relevant notice. Available options: "historical", "discontinued", "future", "unimplemented", "current" (default). ;status notes : Optional. Allows provision of additional reason for the given status. ;status date : Optional. Sets the date of the update that marked this skill as historical (in YYYY-MM-DD format). ;requires : Optional. The expansion or living world season required to access the content. Displays a notice of the required release. See {{tl|infobox requires}} for options. === Examples === 
{{Object infobox
| name = Blueberry Bush
| type = Resource node
| req = Harvesting sickle
| gives = Blueberry
| interaction prompt = Gather
}}
{{Object infobox | name = Blueberry Bush | image = Blueberry Bush.jpg | type = plant | req = Harvesting sickle | gives = Blueberry | interaction prompt = Gather }} {{clear}} 
{{Object infobox
| name = Ethereal Vanguard Monument
| location = Devast District
| type = Hero challenge
| goal = Defeat Captain Mattox and his Ethereal Vanguard
}}
{{Object infobox | name = Ethereal Vanguard Monument | image = Ethereal Vanguard Monument.jpg | location = Devast District | type = Hero challenge | goal = Defeat Captain Mattox and his Ethereal Vanguard }} {{clear}} == See also == * [[Guild Wars 2 Wiki:Object formatting]] [[Category:Infobox templates|Object]]

For most achievements, this template provides API check functionality. A few checks are performed prior to displaying this, see [[#Notes]] below. == Usage == 
{{objectives table header}}
{{objectives table row||}}
|}
=== Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Optional. Name of the achievement (matching property "Has canonical name"). : Note that this parameter defaults to PAGENAME, which instead matches on "Has achievement page" (set by page to be set in [[Template:Achievement table row]]). ;id : Optional on standalone achievement pages. Can be used instead the unnamed parameter 1 on standalone achievement pages to set the id for the API check. : Required for achievements without a standalone achievement page. Set the achievement id to properly enable the API check. ;api : Optional. Achievement api check box, enabled on default. Set to either "true" or "false" to enable/disable the box. ;map : Optional. Map screenshot column, disabled on default. Set to either "true" or "false" to enable/disable the column. ;location : Optional. Location screenshot column, disabled on default. Set to either "true" or "false" to enable/disable the column. ;notes : Optional. Alternative notes column title. Set to "false" to disable the notes column. ;col1 ... col3 : Optional. Additional custom columns that allow any content, e.g. "Location" as text, "Nearest waypoint", "Enemies", etc... Set this parameter to the wanted column title to activate this column. ;class : Optional. Appends a CSS class into the table header in addition to the existing value of "table mech1 sortable". ;objectives width : Optional. Minimum width of the column "Objectives". ;notes width : Optional. Width of the column "Notes". ;col1 width ... col3 width : Optional. Width of the custom columns. ;scope : Optional. Either "objective" (not a wiki page, no icon), or "collection" (wiki page with icon and rarity). Should be auto-detected. ;disable warning : Optional. Allows to disable the warning for [[API:2/achievements|achievements]] that doesn't match the API objectives list by setting it to "true". The API check is not shown. ;custom bit : Optional. Allows to enable the API check by setting it to "true" in order to enable the API check (also disables the warning). This requires also the usage of the parameter "custom bit" in the {{tl|objectives table row}}, and the addition of the achievement ID to [[Template:Achievement id blacklist]]. == Notes == The API check is disabled automatically on the following pages: * Achievement pages which includes several achievements. The template collects the achievement id based on the individual achievement name, if there are several achievements (page in {{tl|achievement table row}}) then the template can't decide for the actually wanted achievement id. Set the parameter ''id'' to enable the API check. * Achievements with the type "meta". Although [[API:2/account/achievements]] provides the unlocked objectives, the [[API:2/achievements]] doesn't list them and hence there's no reasonable way to gain the objectives order used by [[API:2/account/achievements]]. Note that currently the meta achievements are barely documented on an individual achievement page anyways. * Achievements with one of the following ids, last updated: Apr 2023. For these achievements the [[API:2/account/achievements]] uses another objectives order than the in-game and thus how it is documented on the wiki. In this case a visible warning will appear, see [[#Additional parameters]] for further details. ;Blacklisted achievement IDs {| class="wikitable sortable expandable" ! ID ! API ! Achievements with objectives mismatch ! Individual achievement pages using this template {{#arraymap: {{Achievement id blacklist}} |\s|@@@| {{!}}- {{!}} @@@ {{!}} [https://api.guildwars2.com/v2/achievements?id=@@@&lang=en API] {{!}} {{#ask: [[Has game id::@@@]][[Has context::Achievement]]|format=plainlist|template=cname|link=none}} {{#ifeq: {{#vardefineecho:page|{{#ask: [[Has game id::@@@]][[Has context::Achievement]]|?Has achievement page=|mainlabel=-|link=none}}}}|{{#ask: [[Has game id::@@@]][[Has context::Achievement]]|?Has achievement category=|mainlabel=-|link=none}}||([[{{#var:page}}|page]])}} {{!}} {{#if: {{#var:page}}|{{#dpl: title = {{#var:page}} | uses = Template:Objectives table header | resultsheader = [[{{#var:page}}]] }}}} |\n}} |} == See also == * {{tl|Collection table}} — automated list [[Category:Table formatting templates]]

}} }} }} == Description == This template is used to provide a walkthrough style table to explain achievement objectives, providing number, map and free-text parameters. The template includes functionality to detect whether the achievement is a collection (content with icons, such as Items or Skins). If this check determines that the content is a collection, then the icon, type and rarity can be displayed. It is used together with [[Template:Objectives table header]]. == Usage == 
{{Objectives table header}}
{{Objectives table row|}}
{{Objectives table row||}}
|}
=== Parameters === ==== General ==== ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Required. The objective name/description as seen in the achievement objective list. ;2 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Optional. Objectives notes. If unset and the achievement is a collection, then the two parameters ''hint'' and ''notes'' are shown as a fallback. ;map : Optional. Map screenshot, defaults to " map.jpg". Can be set to "none" to disable the image. Requires to set "map = true" in {{tl|Objectives table header}}. ;location : Optional. Location screenshot, defaults to " location.jpg". Can be set to "none" to disable the image. Requires to set "location = true" in {{tl|Objectives table header}}. ;col1 ... col3 : Optional. Additional custom columns that allow any content, e.g. "Zone", "Nearest waypoint", "Enemies", etc... Set ''col1 ... col3'' in {{tl|Objectives table header}} to the column title to activate this column. ==== Customisation options ==== ;class : Optional. This parameter allows a css class to be applied to the row, e.g. "line-top". ;map size : Optional. Map image size, defaults to 150px. ;location size : Optional. Location image size, defaults to 150px. ;indent : Optional. Indents the current line, and provides an arrow pointing to the previous line's icon. Value should be greater than or equal to 1, e.g. 1, 2, 3 ... ;number : Optional. Number displayed at the start of the row. Used as the n-1 default for the API bit. ;custom bit : Optional. If the in-game objectives order doesn't match the API order (the "API bit") then this parameter has to be set to the API bit for each objective. Requires to set the parameter "custom bit" to "true" in the {{tl|Objectives table header}} to enable the API check. Set this parameter to the according achievement objective bit from the API in the table rows, note that it starts with 0. ==== Additional parameters for collections ==== ;icon : Optional. The icon for the collection element. Set the parameter ''large'' in the Objectives table header to double the icon size. ;hint : Optional. If ''unnamed parameter 2'' is not set, displays italic hint text, defaults to the hint set in according collection item infobox. ;notes : Optional. If ''unnamed parameter 2'' is not set, displays additional notes below the parameter == Examples == === Examples for objectives === ;Objectives with notes and map 
{{Objectives table header|Bian's World Tour|map=true}}   
{{Objectives table row|Chat with M.U.P. employee Bian.|map=Bian walking pattern.jpg}}
{{Objectives table row|Find Bian in the Grove.|On the upper terrace of the Starbower Nursery.|map=Bian The Grove.jpg}}

|{{!!}}}} }} == Description == A row template for {{tl|Pact Supply Network Agent table}}. This template generates the locations of the [[Pact Supply Network Agent]]s for a given date or offset. Their location changes at 8 AM every morning. == Parameters == ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' :Time offset. e.g. "+1 day". ;date :A specific date and time to calculate for, e.g. "2015/12/01 09:00". Defaults to "now". ;locations :A comma separated list of locations you wish to display. Defaults to "maguuma wastes, maguuma jungle, orr, kryta, shiverpeaks, ascalon". ;format :Formatting options. Defaults to "table". Other options: "links" (displays a row of chat links), "silent" (just calculates variables). ;rowclass ;rowstyle :Apply an html class and/or style to the row for the "table" option. ;showdate :If specified, shows dates on the link row too. == Examples == === Example #1 ===

revision.text:
<includeonly>
{{#dpl:
| resultsheader = %TOTALPAGES% matching pages found.\n
| noresultsheader = No pages found.
| {{#if: {{{debug|}}} | debug = {{{debug}}} }}
| {{ #if: {{{category|{{{cat|}}}}}} | category = {{{category|{{{cat}}}}}} }}
| {{#if: {{{title|}}} | titlematch = {{{title}}} }}
| namespace = {{{namespace|}}}
| uses = {{#if: {{#pos:{{{1|bug}}}|:}} | {{{1|bug}}} | Template:{{{1|bug}}} }}
| include = {{{{1|bug}}}}:{{{2|1}}}
| table = {{STDT|sortable {{{class|}}}}},page,{{#replace:{{{2|1}}}|:|,}}
| offset = {{{3|0}}}
| count = {{{4|500}}}
| {{#if: {{{title|}}} | noresultsheader = null }}
| ordermethod = title
}}
</includeonly><noinclude>
== Parameters ==
;1 ''(unnamed parameter)''
: Required. The template name. Do not include template prefix.
;2 ''(unnamed parameter)''
: Optional. The parameter name. Defaults to unnamed parameter "1".
;3 ''(unnamed parameter)''
: Optional. The results offset. Defaults to 0.
;4 ''(unnamed parameter)''
: Optional. The number of results to display. Defaults to 500.
;cat, or category
: Optional. The category name.
;title
: Optional. To check a specific page.
;namespace
: Optional. Defaults to main namespace.
;class
: Optional. Adds additional classes to the table.
;debug
: Optional. Useful when results contain "+" signs which breaks tables. Set to a numerical value between 1 and 6.

[[Category:Maintenance templates]]
</noinclude>

The primary use is to format a query for achievements in an achievement category or activity in the {{tl|achievement table header}}. '''#var:table_tier_total''' is used to track the value in between achievements.

}}

{{#var:table_tier_total}}
{{parse tier|Traders Met: 1;3~Traders Met: 3;3~Traders Met: 5;3}} {{#var:table_tier_total}}

== Description == A display template for [[Personal story]] derived from {{tl|Personal storyline project chart}} (used on [[Guild Wars 2 Wiki:Projects/Personal storyline/visual overview]]). API functionality inspired by [https://www.reddit.com/r/Guildwars2/comments/c16jmv/story_progress_visualized_automatically/ a reddit post of /u/dsnider_anet]. Format using {{tl|Personal story chart box}}. == Usage == 
{{Personal story chart}}
[[Category:API formatting templates]] [[Category:Formatting templates]] ---- __NOTOC__
{{Custom CSS|form|css= .chartwrapper { position: relative; } .chartwrapper > h3 { border-bottom: 1px solid #a2a9b1; line-height: 1.4em; } .viewbox { width: 100%; overflow-x:scroll; } .superwide { width: 3500px; border: 1px dashed #aaa; } .horizontal-container { display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex: 1; } .vertical-container { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; } .ps-box, .inv, .bio { padding: 2px; margin: 2px; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; flex: 1; } .ps-box { border: 1px solid black; font-size: smaller; font-weight:bold; background-color: #f2f2f2; } .bio img { margin-top: 0.6em; margin-bottom: 0.4em; } .asura { background-color: #F1EBFD; padding-bottom:0.5em; } .charr { background-color: #FFEBED; padding-bottom:0.5em; margin-left: 1em; } .human { background-color: #FFFBE8; padding-bottom:0.5em; margin-left: 1em; } .norn { background-color: #EAF5FF; padding-bottom:0.5em; margin-left: 1em; } .sylvari { background-color: #E7FBE8; padding-bottom:0.5em; margin-left: 1em; } /* Dark theme colour scheme */ .skin-vector .ps-box { background-color: #40434A; } .skin-vector .asura { background-color: #5C556A; } .skin-vector .charr { background-color: #5E494A; } .skin-vector .human { background-color: #716A4E; } .skin-vector .norn { background-color: #45525E; } .skin-vector .sylvari { background-color: #546855; } }}

| name =
| icon =
| image =
| description =
| family =
| region =
| id =
}}
=== Parameters === ; name : Optional. Defaults to the name of the article. ({{PAGENAME}}). ; icon : Optional. The pet icon. Do not include the File: namespace prefix or the file extension; the template assumes .png format. Defaults to name. ; image : Optional. The pet image. Do not include the File: namespace prefix. Defaults to the page name ({{PAGENAME}}.jpg). ; description : Required. The description shown when you charm the pet. ; family : Required. Pet family name: moa, ursine, drake, etc. ; region : Required. [[Region]] where pet is found, not using the parameter will result in ''Unknown''. If pet is found in multiple regions, separate with commas, e.g.: ''Ascalon, Kryta''. ; archetype : Required. The [[soulbeast]] archetype of a given pet. Available options: "deadly", "ferocious", "stout", "supportive", "versatile" ; underwater : Optional. Defaults to "no", i.e. defaults to stating that a pet is terrestrial. Sets the semantic property [[Property:Is usable underwater|Is usable underwater]]. Options: "yes" (amphibious), "no" (terrestrial), or "only" (aquatic). ; id : Optional. The ID of the pet according to [[API:2/pets|/v2/pets]]. ; categorize : Optional. "y" or "n" to turn on/off categorization. Default is on for main namespace articles and off for others. If using "status", don't set this parameter. ; status : Optional. Status of content. Only set if not currently obtainable ingame, displays relevant notice. Available options: "historical", "discontinued", "future", "unimplemented", "current" (default). ; status notes : Optional. Allows provision of additional reason for the given status. ; requires : Optional. The expansion or living world season required to access the content. Displays a notice of the release. See {{tl|infobox requires}} for options. === Example === 
{{Pet infobox
| name = Juvenile Armor Fish
| image = Juvenile Armor Fish.jpg
| description = This durable fish's armor can withstand a tremendous amount of punishment. Armor fish overwhelm their foes with disorienting bash attacks while shrugging off their counterattacks.
| family = Armored Fish
| region = Ascalon, Kryta, Maguuma Jungle, The Mists
| archetype = Stout
| underwater = only
| id = 40
}}
{{Pet infobox | name = Juvenile Armor Fish | image = Juvenile Armor Fish.jpg | description = This durable fish's armor can withstand a tremendous amount of punishment. Armor fish overwhelm their foes with disorienting bash attacks while shrugging off their counterattacks. | family = Armored Fish | region = Ascalon, Kryta, Maguuma Jungle, The Mists | archetype = Stout | underwater = only | id = 40 }} [[Category:Infobox templates]]

Guild Wars 2 Wiki public sandbox

This is the Guild Wars 2 Wiki public sandbox. You can test out the wiki code etc. here.

Please be aware that absolutely anyone can overwrite your changes and the sandbox will be blanked from time to time, so don't put anything too important here!

When using this sandbox please follow these simple rules:

* Please do not revert each other. * Please leave this notice and the comments at the beginning of this page intact. * Please keep things small enough not to be a hassle to testers. * This page must not be moved. * '''Do not add categories to this page''', this includes categories added by templates like deletion templates etc.. * For tests of simple things, you may not even need to modify this page - just try using '''"Show preview"''' first.

Happy testing!

{{#ifeq: {{{1|}}} | | | {{#iferror:{{#expr:{{{1|}}}}} | {{#ask: [[Has location type::Point of Interest]] [[Has canonical name::{{{1}}}]] | ?Has game id# | ?Has canonical name | format = plainlist | template = Point of interest result format | link = none | default = [[{{{1}}}]]{{#info:Error: No point of interest named "{{{1}}}" found. The page may not have been created yet.}}{{#if: {{NAMESPACE}}||[[Category:Pages with empty semantic mediawiki query results]]}} }} | {{#ask: [[Has location type::Point of Interest]] [[Has game id::{{{1}}}]] | ?Has game id# | ?Has canonical name | format = plainlist | template = Point of interest result format | link = none | default = POI ID: {{{1}}}{{#info: Error: Point of interest with id "{{{1}}}" not found. Check if the page exists and sets the id.}}{{#if: {{NAMESPACE}}||[[Category:Pages with empty semantic mediawiki query results]]}} }} }} }} == Description == Generate a link to a [[Point of Interest]] and its chat link. For this to work, the point of interest must have been defined on an [[area]] page with {{tl|map objective}}. The template will accept either the point of interest name or game id. The mouse-over text of the link will display the area of the location. Formatted using {{tl|Point of interest result format}}. The shortcut {{poi|}} can also be used. [[:Template:Poi]] redirects here. == Usage == === Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' :''point of interest name'' - The name of the point of interest :''point of interest id'' - The game id of the point of interest. Hover over the Game link in the infobox on the article, or check the id value given to the [[:Template:Location infobox]]. === Examples === ;Name 
{{point of interest|Asuran Beachhead}}

{{poi|Asuran Beachhead}}
{{point of interest|Asuran Beachhead}} {{poi|Asuran Beachhead}} ;Game id 
{{point of interest|2392}}

{{poi|2392}}
{{point of interest|2392}} {{poi|2392}} ;Non-existent page

This semantic result template is used for formatting results from {{tl|point of interest}}. The following parameters are passed to the template: #Page name #Has game id #Has canonical name
[[Category:Location formatting templates]] [[Category:Semantic result templates]]

{{{name|{{PAGENAME}}}}}

;Title : {{{title|Unknown}}} ;Host : {{#if: {{{host|}}} | {{#arraymap: {{{host}}} | , | @@@ | [[@@@]] |
}} | Unknown }} ;Guests : {{#if: {{{guests|}}} | {{#arraymap: {{{guests|Unknown}}} | , | @@@ | {{ifexists | @@@ | [[@@@]] | @@@ }} |
}} | Unknown }} ;Date : {{#if: {{{date|}}} | {{#time: F j, Y | {{{date}}} }} | Unknown }} {{#if: {{{link|}}} | ;Official video : [{{{link}}} YouTube] }} {{#if: {{#vardefine:PrevEpisode | {{#expr: {{#explode: {{{name|{{PAGENAME}}}}} | | -1 }} -1 }} }} {{#vardefine:NextEpisode | {{#expr: {{#explode: {{{name|{{PAGENAME}}}}} | | -1 }} +1 }} }} }}{{#ifeq: {{#var:PrevEpisode}} | 0 || ;Previous : [[Points of Interest - Episode {{#var:PrevEpisode}}|{{#var:PrevEpisode}}]] }} ;Next : [[Points of Interest - Episode {{#var:NextEpisode}}|{{#var:NextEpisode}}]] {{clear}}
:''The following is an unofficial, player-written transcript of the episode. The accuracy of this transcription has not been verified by ArenaNet.''{{#if: {{NAMESPACE}} || [[Category:Points of Interest episodes|{{padleft:{{#explode: {{{name|{{PAGENAME}}}}} | | -1 }}|3}} {{{name|{{PAGENAME}}}}}]] }}
 == Description == This infobox is used for episodes of the [[Points of Interest (show)]]. == Usage == === Parameters === ;title :The title of the episode. Omit the first part of the video's title: "Points of Interest Episode ## -". ;host :Name of the episode's host (usually [[Rubi Bayer]]). Multiple hosts are supported, separated by commas. ;guests :Name(s) of other participants in the episode. Separate with commas. ;date :The date the video was uploaded to YouTube. ;link :A link to the video upload on [https://www.youtube.com/user/arenanetofficial/ ArenaNet's official YouTube channel]. ;name :Optional. Sets the title of the infobox. Defaults to the name of the article. === Example === 
{{Points of Interest infobox
| title = [[Entanglement]]
| host = Kate Welch
| guests = Josh Foreman, Tami Foote, Peter Fries
| date = July 18, 2014
| link = https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8GCAPujp6yM
}}
{{Points of Interest infobox | name = Points of Interest - Episode 3 | title = [[Entanglement]] | host = Kate Welch | guests = Josh Foreman, Tami Foote, Peter Fries | date = July 18, 2014 | link = https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8GCAPujp6yM }} [[Category:Infobox templates]]

revision.text:
* Prior to [[End of Dragons]] the effects from [[Polysaturating Reverberating Infusion]]s, [[Hylek Potion]]s, [[Polyluminescent Undulating Refractor]], and [[Polyluminescent Undulating Infusion]]s would only show the last applied effect and a random one upon zoning. * Polysaturating Infusions do not affect character skin. When combined with a Polyluminescent, the skin will never be overridden but the armor and hair will. * The effect does not affect the character's equipped back skins, weapons, or [[glider]]s. * The effect can be combined with certain other infusions such as the [[Celestial Infusion]]. * The effect continues to be displayed even if the item holding the upgrade has its visibility toggled off. == Description == This template is used to display the shared notes on [[Polysaturating Reverberating Infusion]], [[Hylek Potion]], [[Polyluminescent Undulating Refractor]], and [[Polyluminescent Undulating Infusion]]. == Usage == 
{{Poly notes}}
== Example == {{Poly notes}} [[Category:Formatting templates]]

== Description ==
Given an item prefix name, this template outputs the attribute bonuses granted by that prefix. If an {{tl|item stat lookup}} was performed earlier on the page, then the numeric values for the attributes will be filled in.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{prefix attributes|<prefix>}}
{{prefix attributes|<prefix>|[m|f]}}
</pre>

=== Parameters ===
;1 ''(unnamed parameter)''
: Prefix name. All known prefixes listed on [[attribute combinations]] are supported:
:* There are three different Snowflake prefixes - single, dual, and triple attributes. To support all three, a special format is used:
:** <code>snowflake[1|2|3]</code>
:*** [1|2|3] = single, dual, or triple attribute version
:*** Example: <code>snowflake3</code> = triple attribute (toughness, concentration, healing power)
:* There are five different Giver's attribute combinations - single and dual attributes for both armor and weapons, and triple attributes. To support all five, a special format is used:
:** <code>giver[1|2|3][a|w]</code>
:*** [1|2|3] = single, dual, or triple attribute version
:*** [a|w] = armor or weapon
:*** Example: <code>giver2w</code> = dual attribute weapon (expertise, vitality)
:*** Example: <code>giver3a</code> = <code>giver3w</code> = triple attributes (toughness, concentration, and healing power)

;2 ''(unnamed parameter)''
: Rarity code: ''f'' for Fine or ''m'' for Masterwork. This is to support combined fine/masterwork item pages, in conjunction with {{tl|item stat lookup fm}}.

; supertype
: Equipment supertype (optional, infobox usage only). Possible values: "back item", "trinket".

; rarity
: Equipment rarity (optional, infobox usage only). Possible values: "ascended" or "legendary".
: If the equipment rarity is "ascended" or "legendary", and the supertype is "back item" or "trinket", then stat adjustments are made as a result of the lack of a jewel slot.

=== Example ===
<pre>{{item stat lookup|type=axe|level=80|rarity=exotic}}
{{prefix attributes|berserker}}</pre>
{{item stat lookup|type=axe|level=80|rarity=exotic}}{{prefix attributes|berserker}}

<pre>
{{item stat lookup|type=amulet|level=76}}
{{item stat lookup fm}}
{{prefix attributes|cavalier|f}}
{{prefix attributes|cavalier|m}}</pre>
{{item stat lookup|type=amulet|level=76}}{{item stat lookup fm}}{{prefix attributes|cavalier|f}}{{prefix attributes|cavalier|m}}

attributes|@@@|supertype={{#var:supertype}}|rarity={{#var:rarity_std}}}} |\n}} |} == Description == This template is used to describe the stat selection mechanic on certain equipment such as [[legendary weapon]]s. The attributes are generated with a call to the {{tl|prefix attributes}} template. This requires a call to {{tl|Item stat lookup}}, which generally happens in the infobox template. To use this template outside an infobox template, the call to {{tl|Item stat lookup}} must been done explicitly. The prefixes are listed in order they are given. Uses {{tl|prefix display}}, {{tl|prefix requires}}, {{tl|prefix attributes}} to format the output. == Usage == 
{{prefix selection|,...}}
=== Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Comma-separated list of prefixes. To see the full list of possible prefixes, see [[Template:Prefix attributes#Full parameter list]]. Some commonly observed groups of prefixes can also be produced with the following short-hands, which allows the prefix group to be updated in the future without modifying all affected pages: :* all legendary trinket, all ascended trinket :** Used for legendary/ascended trinkets, includes eod prefixes: [[Dragon's]] and [[Ritualist's]] :* all fractals :** Armor pieces and weapons sold by [[BLING-9009]] :* all legendary, all ascended, all exotic :** Used for legendary/ascended/exotic weapons and armor pieces :* all wvw :** WvW weapons: exotic [[Obsidian weapons]], ascended [[Mistforged Obsidian weapons]], ascended [[Mistforged Hero's weapons]] :** WvW armor: ascended [[Triumphant Hero's armor]] and ascended [[Mistforged Triumphant Hero's armor]] :** PvP armor: ascended [[Ardent Glorious armor]] and ascended [[Mistforged Glorious Hero's armor]] :** [[Crystal Desert Reward Track]]: [[Warbeast armor]], [[Bounty Hunter's armor]], [[Elonian armor]] contained in [[Desert Armor Box]] :* all wvw exotic :** WvW weapons: exotic [[Mistforged Hero's weapons]] :** WvW armor: exotic [[Triumphant armor]] and exotic [[Triumphant Hero's armor]] :** PvP armor: exotic [[Glorious armor]] :** [[Legacy Armor Reward Track]]: exotic armor contained in [[Legacy Armor Box]] :* all assaulter, all defender, all healer, or all malicious :* all eod :** (Deprecated) Used for exotic and ascended End of Dragons equipment (except ascended trinkets), includes eod prefixes: [[Dragon's]] and [[ritualist's]] :* all eod trinket :** (Deprecated) Used for ascended End of Dragons trinkets, includes eod prefixes: [[Dragon's]] and [[Ritualist's]] ;no requirements : Optional. Used to disable expansion requirements, automatically disabled for all legendary and all legendary trinket. ;collapsed : Optional. Change the default loading state of the list to collapsed by setting this parameter equal to "y". Where more than 9 prefixes have been specified, the template defaults to the collapsed state. ;id : Optional. Used for subobjects, sets the prefixes to the subobject associated with the "id". ;subobject : Optional. Used for subobjects without "id". Set to the subobject name, i.e. the part behind the hash: #. === Example === {{Weapon infobox | name = Iron Sword | icon = Fine Sword.png | type = Sword | level = 80 | rarity = exotic | gallery1 = Iron Sword.jpg }} 
{{Prefix selection|assassin, berserker, commander, dragon}}

{{!}}- {{!}} * ''No skills found.''{{#if: {{NAMESPACE}}||[[Category:Pages with empty semantic mediawiki query results]]}} {{!}}} | sort = Has profession sort order, Has specialization sort order, Has skill context sort order, Has weapon type sort order, Has attunement sort order, Has skill slot sort order, Has skill type sort order, Has skill sort order, Has chain sequence position }} == Description == This template creates skill tables based on profession, specialization, type, etc... for profession mechanic skills. It corresponds to the table row template {{tl|profession mechanic skill table row}} which can be used to manually create more complex profession mechanic skill tables. Format using {{tl|profession mechanic skill table row format}}. The skills are sorted in the following way: {{Skill sort property chain doc}} == Usage == 
{{profession mechanic skill table|profession=}}
{{profession mechanic skill table|specialization=}}
{{profession mechanic skill table|type=}}
{{profession mechanic skill table|weapon=}}
{{profession mechanic skill table|profession=|specialization=|release=|context=|weapon=|underwater usability=}}
=== Parameters === ;profession : Optional. Profession. Includes elite specialization skills. ;core profession : Optional. Profession. Excludes elite specialization skills. ;specialization : Optional. Elite specialization. ;release : Optional. Release: "Core", "HoT" (Heart of Thorns), "PoF" (Path of Fire) or "EoD" (End of Dragons). ;context : Optional. Either "Profession mechanic" (default) or "Pet". ;weapon : Optional. Weapon. Can be also a bundle or transform skill if ''context'' is set to "Bundle" or "Transform" resp. ;type : Optional. Skill type. ;attunement : Optional. Attunement, either "Fire", "Water", "Air" or "Earth". ;include dual attunement : Optional. If set to "true" dual attunement skills are included, default if "false". ;underwater usability : Optional. Underwater usability, either: "Land" ("land" and "land and underwater skills", i.e. exlcudes underwater skills), "Underwater" (excludes land skills), "Land only" and "Underwater only". ;historical : Optional. Include historical skills: "no" (default), "yes" or "only". ;class : Optional. CSS class. ;query : Optional. Additional query. ;intro : Optional. Can be set to "false" to disable intro header. ;outro : Optional. Can be set to "false" to disable outro footer. ;offset : Optional. Query offset. ;show profession subheader : Optional. Profession subheader, either "true" or "false". Enabled on default, however if ''profession'' or ''specialization'' is set the profession subheader is disabled. ;profession heading : Optional. Profession subheader css heading, default is "h4". Can be set to "plain". ;show chain icon only : Optional. Hides burst, stealth and tool belt icons, shows chain icon only on default. Can be set to "false". ==== [[Template:Profession mechanic skill table header]] parameters ==== ;showType : Optional. Shows type column and displays the property [[Property:Has skill type|Has skill type]], disabled on default. Can be set to "true". ;showWeapon : Optional. Shows weapon column and displays the property [[Property:Is for weapon|Is for weapon]] (e.g. for [[Symbol]] skills), disabled on default. Can be set to "true". ;showPet : Optional. Shows pet column and displays the property [[Property:Is for pet|Is for pet]], disabled on default. Can be set to "true". ;showArchetype : Optional. Shows archetype column and displays the property [[Property:Has pet archetype|Has pet archetype]], disabled on default. Can be set to "true". ;showEnergy : Optional. Shows energy column and displays the property [[Property:Has energy cost|Has energy cost]], disabled on default. Can be set to "true". ;showInitiative : Optional. Shows initiative column and displays the property [[Property:Has initiative cost|Has initiative cost]], disabled on default. Can be set to "true". ;showUnderwater : Optional. Shows underwater icon and displays the property [[Property:Is usable underwater|Is usable underwater]], disabled on default. Can be set to "true". === Example === 
{{Profession mechanic skill table|core profession=Guardian}}
{{Profession mechanic skill table|core profession=Guardian}} 
{{Profession mechanic skill table|type=Shade}}
{{Profession mechanic skill table|type=Shade}}

Rows in the table should use {{tl|Profession mechanic skill table row}}. Only one of the following optional columns can be shown at the same time: ''Type'', ''Weapon'', ''Pet'' or ''Archetype''. == Usage ==
