<onlyinclude>{{Welcome}}</onlyinclude> == Description == Welcome bot. Wrapper template for [[Template:Welcome]] to allow the top level template to be substituted (i.e. <nowiki>{{subst:Welcome/wrapper}}</nowiki>) which then becomes <nowiki>{{Welcome}}</nowiki> without any parameters revealing a user's real name plus only leaves a non-substituted template (i.e. remains as <nowiki>{{Welcome}}</nowiki>) on the page source, allowing for the links in the welcome template to be tweaked later without manually visiting each page (could be useful if one page is moved for example).
[[Category:Maintenance templates]]

{{#Widget:Game update filter classes}} == Description == This is a wrapper template for [[Widget:game update filter classes]] to track its usage. It has no parameters. == Description == This templates is called in the several [[:Category:Infobox templates|infoboxes]] and handles the description for the wiki popups. The description is usually displayed with the template {{tl|quotation}} using
tags which are omitted by the popup extension. Therefore the description is called again with this template for wiki popups only. Sets #var:show in wikipopup to "true", which enables the quotation source in {{tl|quotation}}. This template removes # \n\n and replaces any occurence with  #&10 (breaking otherwise) # * and replaces any occurence with  #&10;•  (breaking otherwise) # \n and replaces any occurence with  #&10 #
and replaces any occurence with  == Usage ==

Uses [[Template:Wintersday Daily rotation/achievement names]]. == Usage == 
{{Wintersday Daily rotation}}
{{Wintersday Daily rotation|}}
=== Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Optional. The UTC date to use as today. Defaults to {{#time: Y-m-d}}. === Example === 
{{Wintersday Daily rotation|2022-12-24}}
{{Wintersday Daily rotation|2022-12-24}} [[Category:Data templates]]

{{#vardefine: index| {{{1|0}}} }}Donation Drive;Sharing the Wintersday Cheer;Yay, Wintersday Presents!;{{#ifexpr: {{#var: index}} mod 2 = 0 | Snowball Mayhem | Saving Wintersday }};{{#switch: {{#expr: {{#var: index}} mod 3 }} | 0 = Toypocalypse Today | 1 = That Wintersday Ring | 2 = Winter Wonderland Winner }};{{#switch: {{#expr: {{#var: index}} mod 4 }} | 0 = Making Some Wintersday Friends | 1 = Dashing Through the Snow | 2 = Spreading Wintersday Joy | 3 = Wintersday Snowball Slinger }} == Description == Provides a semicolon separated list of the names of the achievements in the [[Wintersday Daily]] achievements category that count towards the [[Wintersday Daily#Wintersday Cheer|Wintersday Cheer]] meta achievement. === Composition === * The following achievements are always included: ** [[Wintersday Daily#Donation Drive|Donation Drive]] ** [[Wintersday Daily#Sharing the Wintersday Cheer|Sharing the Wintersday Cheer]] ** [[Wintersday Daily#Yay, Wintersday Presents!|Yay, Wintersday Presents!]] * The following achievements alternate between each other: ** [[Wintersday Daily#Snowball Mayhem|Snowball Mayhem]] ** [[Wintersday Daily#Saving Wintersday|Saving Wintersday]] * The following achievements rotate among themselfs: ** [[Wintersday Daily#Toypocalypse Today|Toypocalypse Today]] ** [[Wintersday Daily#That Wintersday Ring|That Wintersday Ring]] ** [[Wintersday Daily#Winter Wonderland Winner|Winter Wonderland Winner]] * As do the following achievements: ** [[Wintersday Daily#Making Some Wintersday Friends|Making Some Wintersday Friends]] ** [[Wintersday Daily#Dashing Through the Snow|Dashing Through the Snow]] ** [[Wintersday Daily#Spreading Wintersday Joy|Spreading Wintersday Joy]] ** [[Wintersday Daily#Wintersday Snowball Slinger|Wintersday Snowball Slinger]] This makes for a sequence of 12 achievement combinations. == Usage == 
{{Wintersday Daily rotation/achievement names|}}
=== Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' :The index into the sequence of achievement combinations. === Return values === {| {{STDT|mech1}} ! Index ! Raw ! colspan="6" | Formated |- {{#arraymap: {{numbers|0|11}} |,|@@@| ! @@@ {{!}} {{#vardefineecho: achievement names| {{Wintersday Daily rotation/achievement names| @@@ }} }} {{#arraymap: {{#var: achievement names}} |;|$$$| {{!}} [[Wintersday Daily#$$$|$$$]] |\n}} {{!}}- |\n}} |} [[Category:Data templates]]

revision.text:
{{#if: {{{track|}}}{{{category|}}}{{{style|}}} | {{#Widget:Wizard's vault objectives|track={{{track|}}}|category={{{category|}}}|style={{{style|}}}}} | {{#Widget:Wizard's vault objectives|category=Special|style=display:inline-block; vertical-align:top;}} }}
== Usage == This template uses [[Widget:Wizard's vault objectives]] to create an API generated list of potential [[Wizard's Vault]] objectives. As the API does not distinguish between whether daily and weekly objectives are currently available, this widget is most practically used to show the currently available Special objectives, as such it defaults to show only Special objectives. 
{{Wizard's vault objectives widget}}
=== Parameters === ;style :Adds additional html styles to the wrapper div. display:inline-block; vertical-align:top; etc ;category :Limits the visible objectives to those categories specified. Daily, Weekly, or Special. Can display more than one category by separating multiple filters with a comma. ;track :Limits the visible objectives to those tracks specified. PvE, PvP, or WvW. Can display more than one track by separating multiple filters with a comma. === Example wikicode === 
{{Wizard's vault objectives widget}}
{{Wizard's vault objectives widget}} 
{{Wizard's vault objectives widget|track=PvE,PvP,WvW|category=Weekly}}
{{Wizard's vault objectives widget|track=PvE,PvP,WvW|category=Weekly}} [[Category:Widget templates]]

Event || Start || Countdown || Zone || Area || Waypoint link {{#ask: [[Has world boss event type::+]] [[Has canonical name::{{{1|+}}}]] [[Spawns at time::>15 April 2014 00:00]] | mainlabel = - | ?Has world boss event object | ?DUMMY | ?Spawns at time#-F[H]=Spawns at time (hour) | ?Spawns at time#-F[i]=Spawns at time (minute) | sort = Spawns at time | format = template | template = World boss table row | link = none | limit = {{#if: {{{1|}}} | 12 | 150 }} | searchlabel = }} |} {{#Widget:World boss timer|showAllRows={{#if:{{{1|{{{show all|}}}}}}|true|false}}}} == Description == This template uses [[World boss/data]] to generate a countdown timer for world boss events. Results are displayed using [[Template:World boss table row]], and the countdown timer is supplied by [[Widget:World boss timer]]. == Usage == 
{{world boss table}}
{{world boss table|}}
The first format will limit the displayed output to spawns in the next hour. The second format will display all spawn times for the specified boss. === Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Optional. Boss name. Used to filter the table to a specific boss; boss name should be one of the canonical names defined on [[World boss/data]]. If a boss name is specified, the table will be sorted from 00 to 24 hours, otherwise the table sorts based on the current time. ; show all :Optional. If specified, all rows will be shown, irregardless of how long it is until the next event. [[Category:Data templates]]

{{#var:Reward tracks per playtime}} }} |} A template for [[Form:WvW skirmish pip query]]. == Usage == Used via the form. === Parameters === ;skirmish ticket target :Target number of tickets to acquire. Defaults to "365". ;max playtime :Maximum playtime in hours. Defaults to "24". ;war score placement low ;war score placement mid ;war score placement high :Estimates of the ratio of time (percentage) for which your world has the high/middle/low warscore vs the other two worlds. Defaults to "33" percent for low/high and "34" percent for middle place. ;rank :The player's rank. Options: "None (1-149)", "Bronze (150-619)", "Silver (620-1394)", "Gold (1395-2544)", "Platinum (2545-4094)", "Mithril (4095-6444)", "Diamond (6445-9999)", "Max (10000)" Defaults to "None (1-149)". ;commander :The ratio of time (percentage) spent commanding a private squad. Defaults to "0" percent. ;publiccommander :The ratio of time (percentage) spent commanding a public squad. Defaults to "0" percent. ;commitment :Whether the previous week of commitment was completed. Options: "Yes", "No". Defaults to "Yes". ;map :The type of map being played on. Only affects reward track progress as Edge of the Mists has less rewards per pip than Eternal Battleground/Alpine Borderlands/Desert Borderland. Options: "Core WvW map", "Edge of the Mists". Defaults to "Core WvW map". ;participation : Participation tier as shown when hovering over the mini map. Only affects reward track progress. Options: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Defaults to 6. ;enhancement : Whether a guild WvW reward track enhancement tavern buff is being used. Options: No, 3%, 4%, 5%, 6%, 7%, 8%, 9%, 10%. Defaults to "10%". ;enrichment : Whether a WvW reward track enrichment amulet upgrade is being used. Options: No, Yes. Defaults to "Yes". ;xp boost : Whether an Experience Booster is being used. Only affects reward track progress. Options: No, Yes. Defaults to "No". ;c boost : Whether a Celebration Booster is being used. Only affects reward track progress. Options: No, Yes. Defaults to "No". ;bl boost : Whether a Black Lion Booster is being used. Only affects reward track progress. Options: No, Yes. Defaults to "No". ;g boost : Whether a Festival Gobbler Boost is active. Only affects reward track progress. Options: No, Yes. Defaults to "No". ;resting : Whether a Homestead Resting effect is active. Only affects reward track progress. Options: No, 2%, 4%, 6%, 8%. Defaults to "No". ;call of war : Whether the Call of War effect is active. Only affects reward track progress. Options: No, Yes. Defaults to "No". ;previous platinum : Whether the player completed platinum rank the previous week. Uses war score placement low/mid/high to estimate average number of weekly tickets acquired due to weekly matchup rewards due to team placement. Options: No, Yes. Defaults to "Yes". [[Category:Form templates]]
